title: skills(objectstack-ui, objectstack-i18n): teach the action param dialog's `submitText` (button verb instead of Confirm) and its translation slot
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28188 (card #27944), which declares `ActionSchema.submitText` without touching `skills/**` (governed, so it waits for its own Tier H PR). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (skills lane).
Reader: the skills lane, next PR that touches `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "skills objectstack-ui actions submitText param dialog submit button label" → 13 hits; #27944 and #28158 are the key and its renderer, #27059 is the record page, none teaches the key. **New.**
reach: authoring guidance only; no door.
Blocked-by: #28188 (the key), and #28158 (the console draws it) before the skill teaches it as live.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: an action with `params` can set `submitText` ("Send", "Log Call") instead of the dialog's default "Confirm". It is an I18nLabel; it is refused on an action without a non-empty `params`, and refused blank. It is not `confirmText` (the confirm dialog's message on a param-less action). `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` are refused with a rename to `submitText`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: one case where the prompt asks for a param dialog whose button says the verb, expecting `submitText` beside `params`.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: the translation slot `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText` (and `globalActions.ACTION.submitText` for an object-less action) in the action-copy list.
- If it lands before #28158, teach the key as declared but not yet drawn (the liveness row is `planned` with `authorWarn`).

Related: #27944 / PR #28188, #28158.
